purpose: Provide persistent temporal plausibility for character duty, travel, rest, social activity and availability.
rules: A character cannot perform physically incompatible activities simultaneously.
Shift assignment defines expected duty availability, not forced physical location.
Conversation and social interaction consume time.
Emergencies may preempt lower-priority activities but must leave an event/state trace.
Rescheduling requires a plausible new window.
Off-screen activity resolution must respect schedule compatibility.
LOD reduction cannot execute incompatible intentions in parallel.
The player cannot create free time or teleport an NPC by initiating interaction.
AI may describe or reason from schedule state but cannot invent availability or mutate authoritative schedule state directly.
core_rpg_boundary: Generic schedule arbitration, time exclusivity, travel occupancy and catch-up semantics should live in CoreRPG when available; this contract defines Star Trek-facing requirements.
